subject: [PATCH 7/8] mm/gup: walk multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the follow_page_pte() function in the Linux kernel's mm/gup.c file by allowing it to walk multiple PTEs per call, rather than one PTE at a time. This reduces the number of page table descents and lock acquisitions, resulting in improved performance for __get_user_pages() calls. The patch was measured to reduce median get times by 2-3x for certain workloads.
